title: Alcohol, Drugs and Substance use
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner identifies drugs commonly abused by youths in Kenya, discusses why young people abuse them, explores effects on the individual and family, reads the scriptures provided (1 Corinthians 3:17, 6:10; Ephesians 5:18; Proverbs 20:1, 23:29-35; Isaiah 5:11) and recommends values and life skills to stay free.

floor.question: What does Ephesians 5:18 say?
floor.answer: Do not get drunk on wine, but be filled with the Spirit

representations: a web: causes, effects on self, effects on family
steps: Explore effects on self and family.
contexts: a youth who recovered from addiction

board.say: What do the scriptures teach about alcohol?

board.do: Wait for the learner to give the warning.
List values and life skills to stay free.

listen_for: None that are sold in shops
misconceptions.ask: Which of these is a commonly abused drug?
misconceptions.repair: List commonly abused substances in Kenya: alcohol, tobacco, bhang, miraa, glue, prescription pills. Legal does not mean safe.

misconceptions.ask: Which is an effect of drug abuse on the family?
misconceptions.repair: Chart effects on the person (health, school, crime) and on the family (money, violence, shame).

misconceptions.ask: What should you do if a friend offers drugs?
misconceptions.repair: Practise three refusal lines and walk away; name the friend who will stand with you.

misconceptions.ask: What does Proverbs 20:1 say about wine and beer?
misconceptions.repair: Read Proverbs 20:1 and 23:29-35 and list the harms they name.

checks.question: Name a drug commonly abused by youths in Kenya.
Recommend a life skill to stay drug-free.
